scope: Local absolute paths replaced with portable references; local branch labels omitted; file-size and parent artifact checksums refreshed. No financial result, model configuration, engine source, or recorded run date changed.
path_convention: Paths beginning research/ or nvda_quant_model/ are repository-relative; legacy_workspace/ denotes the prior workspace, whose unshipped artifacts may not be present in this repository.
historical_reproduction_scope: REPRODUCTION_CHECK.json records verification of the original 2026-09-18 files. Published metadata bytes differ; original and published hashes are recorded below. This publication was not a new model run.
numeric_fingerprint_method: JSON numeric leaves, excluding byte-size metadata fields named bytes; CSV numeric cells identified by decimal/scientific/NaN/Inf lexical format. Field paths or cell coordinates are included in the digest.
